title: Repair the Boundary, Not the Skills: Contract-Guided Adapter Synthesis for LLM-Agent Skill Composition (Software and Reproducibility Artifacts)
description:
This versioned archive contains the implementation, frozen protocols, native execution records, tests, analyses, manuscript sources, and reproducibility instructions for Contract-Guided Boundary Adapter Synthesis (CGBAS).

CGBAS repairs an already diagnosed cross-Skill interface conflict by compiling a witness-backed boundary adapter without rewriting the component Skills. The independent confirmation contains 74 identifier-disjoint ALFWorld and ScienceWorld tasks, 226 state-matched causal conflicts, and 71 healthy controls. CGBAS achieved 100.0% constrained native repair success versus 49.6% for the frozen strongest local comparator, a 50.4-point gain (95% task-clustered bootstrap CI 46.6--54.6; two-sided task sign-randomization p = 0.00001) with zero healthy-control loss.

The archive includes integrity manifests and CPU-only verification scripts. Third-party ALFWorld data, ScienceWorld assets, and model weights are not redistributed; pinned identifiers, revisions, paths, licenses, and integrity checks are provided instead.
